sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí gōngsī hěn yuǎn.
sentences.english_hint: My home is far from work.
sentences.scenario: Explain why your commute is long.
sentences.source_note: Repeated hesitation with 离; learner described a two-hour drive to work.

sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn.
sentences.english_hint: The park is near my home.
sentences.scenario: Describe the park near your home.
sentences.source_note: Learner described a nearby park; reinforces the core 离 pattern.

sentences.english_hint: Is there a subway station nearby?
sentences.scenario: Ask a passerby about nearby transit.
sentences.source_note: Core lesson question; learner understood it but needs automatic production.

sentences.chinese: 一直走到前面路口左拐。
sentences.pinyin: Yìzhí zǒu dào qiánmiàn lùkǒu zuǒ guǎi.
sentences.english_hint: Go straight and turn left at the intersection ahead.
sentences.scenario: Give directions to the next intersection.
sentences.source_note: Analysis explicitly recommends this route chunk; learner struggled with the sequence.

sentences.scenario: Give the final step of a route.
sentences.source_note: Repeated route pattern; learner successfully repeated 右拐就到了.

sentences.english_hint: Go past the park and you're there.
sentences.scenario: Use a park as a landmark when giving directions.
sentences.source_note: Analysis targets 经过……就到了; park was used to explain the route.

sentences.chinese: 博物馆在和平饭店对面。
sentences.english_hint: The museum is opposite the Peace Hotel.
sentences.scenario: Locate the museum on the lesson map.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this complete location sentence; learner produced the location with hesitation.
Direct correction of 我工作家里; learner currently works from home.

sentences.chinese: 开车去公司要两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Kāichē qù gōngsī yào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.english_hint: Driving to work takes two hours.
sentences.scenario: Explain how long your drive to work takes.
sentences.source_note: Learner repeatedly struggled with 两个小时 and described this commute duration.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè qù yí cì gōngsī.
sentences.english_hint: I go to the office once a month.
sentences.source_note: Analysis explicitly recommends this sentence for the learner's monthly office visits.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ sì ge yuè méiyǒu shuō Zhōngwén.
sentences.english_hint: I haven't spoken Chinese for four months.
sentences.scenario: Explain your speaking gap when resuming lessons.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 我不说中文四个月.

sentences.english_hint: I use software to study Chinese.
sentences.scenario: Describe how you study between lessons.
sentences.source_note: Generalizes the corrected 用Duolingo和Anki学中文 pattern without English brand names.

sentences.english_hint: I want to travel to China.
sentences.scenario: Tell someone about your travel goal.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 我想旅游中国; learner repeatedly discussed visiting China.

sentences.chinese: 我太太两年以后想工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tàitai liǎng nián yǐhòu xiǎng gōngzuò.
sentences.english_hint: My wife wants to work in two years.
sentences.scenario: Describe your wife's future work plans.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this corrected sentence; learner hesitated over work and 两年以后.
